'''Z90 Division''' was a unit in the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Army]]. Z90 fielded [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|AAT]] and [[NR-N99 Persuader-class droid enforcer/Legends|''Persuader''-class]] tanks and [[OG-9 homing spider droid/Legends|OG-9 homing spider droids]].
